1 Chips: the Now list's groups, one tap hides a group. 2 Layers: each layer carries its honest label; cameras sit at modelled positions, pumps are emulated until KMC grants access. 3 Selection card: risk class, depth band, lead time and

the four drivers with their labels. 4 A forecast crossing. 5 A voice field report on the map, dashed until an officer confirms it. Marks: small dashed square = camera (modelled position) · P = pump (emulated) · triangle = tide point
